{{Quote|Gen Tiraan has committed no crimes against the New Republic, but is included in this document due to his specialized skills.|General Airen Cracken, "Wanted by Cracken"|<ref name="WBC" />}}
'''Gen Tiraan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] in [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]]. He worked as a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] for [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] and was a member of the [[X-wing development team|team]] that developed the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]. He left Incom after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], relocated to the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], and developed a new [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engine]], which in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] attracted the attention of both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

By that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the New Republic had posted a [[Bounty/Legends|reward]] of 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for his capture, even though he had committed no crimes against the fledgling government. A description of Tiraan, including his past, was included in [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken's]] [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] dossier "[[Wanted by Cracken]]."

==Biography==
===Trust me, I'm an engineer!===
{{Quote|His efforts while designing the X-wing prove that Tiraan is capable of radical advances in engineering given a free hand and sufficient credits.|General Airen Cracken, "Wanted by Cracken"|<ref name="WBC" />}}
[[File:Incom.svg|thumb|left|200px|The logo of Incom Corporation, Tiraan's most prominent employer]]
In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> Gen Tiraan was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]],<ref name="WBC" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]].<ref name="Chandrila">{{CSWECite|I|119|Chandrila}}</ref> From an early age, he developed a talent for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] and commenced employment with the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] in that capacity. There, he joined a [[X-wing development team|design team]] that created the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]],<ref name="WBC" /> which later became a hallmark of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Xwing">{{CSWECite|III|345|X-wing starfighter}}</ref> When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] nationalized the Incom Corporation, Tiraan was forced to continue working for the company,<ref name="WBC" /> even when members of Incom's senior design staff defected to the Alliance with plans and prototypes of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="Xwing" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="WBC" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="date" /> Tiraan left Incom. Knowledge of his availability for employment spread, and he was sent multiple job offers from various companies, but he refused most of them. He chose to work for a [[Unidentified shipping company|shipping company]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] and,<ref name="WBC" /> by [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="date" /> he designed an innovative [[Sublight engine/Legends|engine]] that was more efficient than other models of the [[Time/Legends|time]]. This drew the attention of both the Empire, who sought skilled engineers to rebuild their [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]], and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], who wished to prevent Tiraan's skills from falling into the Empire's employ.<ref name="WBC" />

===The hunt for the engineer===
{{Quote|&hellip;while no formal charges have been levied against him, refusal to cooperate could result in warrants being issued for his arrest.|General Airen Cracken, "Wanted by Cracken"|<ref name="WBC" />}}
[[File:Tiraansmission.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Scrambled image of the engine's specifications]]
By that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the New Republic had issued a small [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to capture Tiraan. New Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] included the engineer in the "Special Cases" section of his dossier "[[Wanted by Cracken]]," a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] containing details for individuals of interest to the New Republic. In it, Cracken advised New Republic agents that in approaching Tiraan, they should warn him that a warrant for arrest may be issued if he was uncooperative. From one of the Corellian [[Star system/Legends|system's]] planets, Tiraan sent a scrambled transmission containing technical specifications of the engine he had designed. A [[Unidentified New Republic agent (Gen Tiraan)|New Republic agent]] intercepted the transmission, although the New Republic struggled to decipher it.<ref name="WBC" />

{{RPGseed}}
A group of New Republic agents were tasked with finding and recovering Tiraan before the Empire could kidnap him entered the Corellian system. The agent who intercepted the transmission provided them a copy as they arrived in-system and advised the group that the Imperials were trying to force him to their service.<ref name="WBC" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He was forced to remain with Incom after nationalization by the Empire, and remained there until the fall of the Empire, shortly after the Battle of Endor.|General Airen Cracken, "Wanted by Cracken"|<ref name="WBC" />}}
[[File:Corellian_Slip_TCG.png|thumb|left|200px|A pair of X-wings that Giraan helped to design]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Tiraan stood 1.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had facial [[Hair/Legends|hair]] styled as a goatee, while the hair on his head was straight and parted down the middle. He was a hardworking, smart, and ambitious individual, becoming the youngest member of Incom's X-wing design team. Tiraan also knew his capabilities, refusing offers from several companies after leaving Incom.<ref name="WBC" />

While a compliant citizen of the Empire who did not take the opportunity to defect, the engineer still had to be forced to continue working for Incom when the Empire nationalized the company. After developing the new sublight engine, he similarly did not take to the Empire's efforts to recruit him, prompting the Empire to hound him in an attempt to force him to their service. Tiraan was not prone to breaking the law, attracting no charges or warrants for arrest by the New Republic.<ref name="WBC" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Subject later joined Incom, and distinguished himself as the youngest member of the team that created the Incom X-wing Space Superiority Starfighter.|General Airen Cracken, "Wanted by Cracken"|<ref name="WBC" />}}
[[File:Gen_Tiraans_R2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Tiraan's personal R2 unit]]
Tiraan was skilled in engineering of starships, including starfighters and [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. This was developed even in his early years, and he was the youngest member of the X-wing development team. He also had technical abilities, capable of programming, repairing, and maintaining [[Droid/Legends|droids]], such as his own [[Gen Tiraan's R2-series astromech droid|R2-series astromech droid]]. The engineer had the acumen and capability to scramble a transmission containing sensitive schematics prior to transmitting, such that it required much effort by the New Republic to unscramble it.<ref name="WBC" />

==Equipment==
Tiraan wore a short sleeve [[shirt]] with an [[Clothing/Legends|apron]] on top to protect the shirt from stains. He had [[Limb/Legends|fingerless]] [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] that could have tools and a pouch attached to it. The pants Tiraan wore had long and round pockets on the thighs that could hold smaller hand tools, and he wore flat-soled shoes on his feet. The engineer often carried a [[pocket computer]], [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] alongside his various tools. Tiraan also had his own [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] that accompanied him.<ref name="WBC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gen Tiraan was introduced in [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], a [[1993]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]]. An image of Tiraan accompanied his entry in the book, illustrated by [[Mike Jackson]],<ref name="WBC" /> who had modeled the engineer on<ref name="GT">{{DeviantArt|username=steampoweredmikej|url=steampoweredmikej/art/Star-Wars-Gen-Tiraan-343829756|name=[[Mike Jackson]]|text=Star Wars &ndash; Gen Tiraan}}</ref> an uncredited<ref name="WBC" /> [[Mike Fitzpatrick]].<ref name="GT" /> For the game, Tiraan has high boosts to his technical skills, particularly "[[Realspace/Legends|space]] transports repair" and "starfighter repair."<ref name="WBC" />
